The Moonwatch.look: The party's airship, a captured Aundairian Broadsword: a long wooden sailing-ship hull of brown planks with a sharp pointed prow and a small blue flame at the bow tip, an open planked deck with hatches, and no masts. Instead, ribbed cream canvas batwing sails stick out sideways from the hull like fins: one large pair amidships and fans of smaller swept-back sails toward the stern on each side. A round brass elemental ring is set into the stern deck, and roaring blue elemental flame streams out behind the ship.
The Moonwatch.short: the party's wooden airship, batwing sails out to the sides like fins, blue elemental flame at the stern

The Kunai.look: The Sentinels' small dropship: a compact arrowhead-shaped craft with a lacquered red hull trimmed in riveted brass, a blue glass canopy over the cockpit at the nose, flared swept-back wings, and four round brass turbine housings on its flanks.
The Kunai.short: small red-and-brass Sentinel dropship with brass turbines and a glass cockpit

Shuriken fighter.look: A small one-man fighter airship: a long brass lance-spike at the nose, a blue glass cockpit bubble, a riveted brass-and-tan hull, brass cannon barrels along both sides, and swept-back red batwing sails at the rear.
Shuriken fighter.short: one-man brass fighter with a lance nose and red batwing sails

The Kingsblade.look: A huge Brelish Galifar-class warship: a long narrow hull with a pointed prow, grey and brass armour plating, decks of teal glass panels laced with pipework, rows of crystal-studded cannons glowing blue along both sides, and a broad red-and-brass stern with swept wings ending in large turbine wheels, blasting red and blue fire behind it.
The Kingsblade.short: huge armoured Brelish warship with blue crystal cannons and fire at the stern

The Broadaxe.look: An airship with a long wooden sailing-ship hull and a pointed prow, four large red-and-white spoked paddle-wheel rotors on outriggers at its sides, a big black iron steam engine at the stern belching black smoke, and a long red-and-teal rudder bar across the stern.
The Broadaxe.short: wooden airship with red paddle-wheel rotors and a smoking black steam engine

The Empyrean.look: Thaddeus Cannith's massive, gaudy luxury airship: a long pointed hull of polished wood decks and pale stone walkways, a swimming pool at the bow, a glass-domed lounge, twin brass funnels, a great domed glass rotunda at the stern, blue-and-gold hull sides with gold filigree and small lifeboats, wrapped along both sides by two huge loops of crackling blue elemental energy.
The Empyrean.short: huge gaudy luxury airship, blue-and-gold hull, glass domes, two loops of blue lightning
